description: Track MySQL LTS instead of Docker Hub's latest (Innovation) tags for MySQL pins in chart values.

mysql-lts.description: Docker Official Images tag list for mysql. Returns the versions the mutable `lts` tag points to (X.Y and X.Y.Z), so pinned tags follow LTS releases instead of Innovation releases.

customManagers.description: MySQL image pins in chart values (`image: mysql:X.Y`, `imageOverride: docker.io/library/mysql:X.Y`, `repository: library/mysql` + `tag: X.Y.Z`), tracked against the current MySQL LTS. Docker versioning only proposes versions with the same precision as the pin (X.Y or X.Y.Z).

packageRules.description: MySQL: do not offer Docker Hub's latest tags (Innovation releases, e.g. 26.x). custom.mysql-lts proposes LTS updates for the same values instead.
MySQL LTS datasource returns no release timestamps; the org minimumReleaseAge would block it forever.
